title: Autoware Index validation history record
description: Schema for one NDJSON line in history/<distro>/<package>.ndjson on the orphan data branch. Append-only.

sweep_kind.description: release = autoware_versions gained an entry. eager = a package's ref changed via PR merge. nightly = daily branch-tip re-test.

ref_at_test.description: The registered ref at the moment of testing. Captured so swapping the registration later doesn't make old records ambiguous.

resolved_sha.description: Actual commit sha tested. For kind=branch, this is the result of git ls-remote at sweep time.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the test concluded.

actions_run_url.description: Link to the GitHub Actions run that produced this record.
